name: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.

pe.note: negative earnings (adjusted quarterly loss of $0.11/share in Q2 2026)

catalysts.headline: Iovance raises FY2026 total revenue guidance to $410-420M (from $350-370M) on strong Amtagvi and Proleukin commercial demand; shares surged
catalysts.impact: Stock up roughly 31.5% (one source) to 38.6% (another) intraday/close, continuing higher into 09-30; H.C. Wainwright raised its price target from $9 to $20

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: record product revenue $99.3M (+66% YoY), adjusted loss per share $0.11 (beat estimate by $0.02), gross margin improved to 56% from 41% in Q1

conflicts: Magnitude of the Sept 29 move is reported inconsistently: +31.5% vs +38.6% for what appears to be the same session; both given, not reconciled.

Closing price also inconsistent: one source cites the stock 'ended the last session 31.5% higher at $14.45,' another describes a close of $14.93 on 09-30 after 'a wild two-day move from around $11 to the mid-teens.' Used $14.93 (most recent) as the last price.
Short interest figures conflict (88.14M vs 115.07M shares) -- both readings given, point estimate left null.

Market cap ($4.98B) sourced as of 2026-09-28, i.e. before the guidance-raise rally, and has not been reconciled against the post-rally price (~452.97M shares x $14.93 implies ~$6.76B); flagged rather than recalculated since no source explicitly reported a post-rally market cap.
